blight_spread.jaymoskingdoms.grief.2: We should have found the cure. We should have found it in time.
blight_spread.jaymoskingdoms.grief.3: That isn't %s any more. Get away from it.
blight_quarantine.jaymoskingdoms.out.0: You. That cough. Out of this town, now, before you give it to all of us.
blight_quarantine.jaymoskingdoms.out.1: I know that cough. Take it outside the walls and don't come back until it's gone.
blight_quarantine.jaymoskingdoms.out.2: You've the grey cold in you. Leave. I won't tell you twice.
blight_quarantine.jaymoskingdoms.take.0: I told you to go. Now you'll go where we put you.
blight_quarantine.jaymoskingdoms.take.1: Still here? Then you're coming with us.
blight_quarantine.jaymoskingdoms.take.2: You were warned. Take hold of them!
blight_quarantine.jaymoskingdoms.cells.0: Into the cells. You'll stay there until it's out of you, one way or the other.
blight_quarantine.jaymoskingdoms.cells.1: Down you go. Pray someone brings you a cure.
blight_quarantine.jaymoskingdoms.cells.2: Keep your cough behind iron. We'll see what you are come morning.
blight_quarantine.jaymoskingdoms.lawless: Better you dead now than walking later.
I'll put you down before you turn.
message.jaymoskingdoms.blight_quarantine: You're shut in the cells until the blight leaves you, cured or turned. Dig out and you're an outlaw.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.cured_blight.0: I'd be one of the dead by now if not for you, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.cured_blight.1: I still feel the cold sometimes, %1$s. Then I remember you brought me back from it.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.cured_blight.2: Anything you need, %1$s. You gave me my life back.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.cured_blight: %3$s says you cured them of the blight, %1$s. Is it true?
You're the one who saved %3$s from the grey cold, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.cured_blight: %1$s cured %3$s of the Hollow's blight. A good soul, that one.
%3$s would be walking with the dead if %1$s hadn't come.
work.jaymoskingdoms.cure_sick.title: Cure the Sick %s
work.jaymoskingdoms.cure_sick.notice: Paid work. The grey cold has got into the town, and the sick are coughing it onto the rest. Pull it off the board to take it.
work.jaymoskingdoms.cure_sick.text: %1$s of %3$s's people have the Hollow's blight in them. Before the day is out they'll rise as the dead. Find a cure (the druids of the groves brew one, and the witches hide theirs) and give it to them.
work.jaymoskingdoms.burn_dead.title: Burn the Blighted Dead %s
work.jaymoskingdoms.burn_dead.notice: Paid work. Some of the town died with the grey cold in them, and they won't stay down. Pull it off the board to take it.
work.jaymoskingdoms.burn_dead.text: %1$s of %3$s's dead had the blight in them when they died. Come nightfall they'll get up. Burn the bodies before then, or see them into the ground.
work.jaymoskingdoms.burn_dead.objective: Burn or bury the blighted dead of %4$s: %1$s of %2$s
work.jaymoskingdoms.failed.sick_gone: The sick are gone, and you cured none of them.
work.jaymoskingdoms.failed.dead_rose: One of the blighted dead got up before you burned it.
